messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Playbook (draft) — stakeholders, milestones, and preferred close windows

Hi Ben / Sarah —

Thanks again for the call today. Attached is an initial Mutual Playbook (MAP) I drafted from our discovery — captured the key goals, success metrics, and the main dependencies we discussed. High-level recap and proposed options below so we can lock the kickoff and owners quickly.

Recap (from today’s discovery)
- Primary objective: Pilot Redwood inference for search ranking and product recommendations to reduce latency and cut per-query cost (~40%).
- Success metrics: 90th percentile tail latency < 120ms; inference cost/unit <= $0.0008; measured uplift on A/B NDCG > 3%.
- Scope for pilot: 1 region (us-west), using quantized open model variant, 250k daily requests peak.
- Key blockers: security questionnaire, procurement SOW, and internal performance sign-off.

Proposed milestone options (high level) — pick one target-close window:
1) Standard (90 days) — Target close: 2027-02-01
   - Week 1–2: MAP kickoff + stakeholder alignment (Novus owners listed below)
   - Week 3–6: Security & compliance review + environment setup
   - Week 7–10: Pilot run + QoS tuning
   - Week 11–12: Evaluate metrics + rollout decision
2) Accelerated (60 days) — Target close: 2027-01-15 (condensed parallel tracks; requires procurement prioritized)

Proposed owners (please confirm or add):
- Product / success: Ben Turner (Novus) — program owner
- Eng / implementation: Sarah Lim (Novus) — integration lead
- AE: Jordan Blake (Redwood) — commercial owner
- Solutions Eng: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — technical lead

Dependencies / asks from Novus:
- Security questionnaire answers + SOC2 scoping (add contact for security): __
- Procurement timeline and PO lead
- Test dataset access (anonymized) for early perf tuning
Attaching: novus_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook) and discovery-notes-20261102.pdf.

Asks / next steps
1) Please confirm the stakeholder roster above and add any missing names/roles (security, legal, procurement).
2) Pick a preferred target-close window (60-day accelerated or 90-day standard) — we’ll adjust the milestone dates accordingly.
3) Quick RSVP: are you available for a 30-minute MAP kickoff call this week (options Wed 11/4 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 11/5 14:00–15:00 PT)?

I’ll incorporate your edits into the MAP and send a version with explicit deliverables and JIRA/action items.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi

Irene — thanks for the clear summary and the draft MAP. A few quick edits from our side: 

- Confirm owners: add Priya Natarajan (Security) and Rafael Mendes (Procurement) to the primary stakeholder list.
- Procurement: Rafael expects a two-week review after we provide the SOW; he’ll push if we indicate an accelerated timeline.
- Preferred target: we are leaning toward the Accelerated (60-day) track if Redwood can support parallel security and environment setup. That would put the target close around 2027-01-15.

We’ll attach a short procurement checklist and I’ll loop Rafael into the thread if that’s okay. Also, we can do the kickoff on Thu 11/5 14:00 PT — that works best for my team.
